body.name: Reduced whole-set confidence region
body.construction: With \(\rho_z(\alpha)=[\log(m/\alpha)+(d-1)\log(n_z+1)]/n_z\), set \(\mathcal K_\alpha(\widehat s)=\{s'\in\mathcal S:D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\widehat s_z\|s'_z)\le\rho_z(\alpha)\ \forall z\}\) and \(\widehat\Theta_\alpha=\bigcup_{s'\in\mathcal K_\alpha(\widehat s)}\Theta(s')\).
